name: polynucleotide kinase 3'-phosphatase

function.text: PNKP encodes bifunctional polynucleotide phosphatase/kinase [Includes: Polynucleotide 3'-phosphatase (2'(3')-polynucleotidase); Polynucleotide 5'-hydroxyl-kinase]. Annotated molecular activities include ATP-dependent polydeoxyribonucleotide 5'-hydroxyl-kinase activity and endonuclease activity. It participates in DNA repair and regulation of DNA repair.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to microcephaly, seizures, and developmental delay (autosomal recessive); ataxia - oculomotor apraxia type 4 (autosomal recessive). Additional curated associations are listed below.
